title: "Finance cutover packet"

updatedAt: "2026-11-11"

Finance (`apps/finance`) already has native Start + Void source on `main`. Its
design, route ownership, qualification and the direct-cutover procedure are in
[Finance and Pay on Start](/build/devops/finance-pay-start). This page holds the
values the release owner needs.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | Profile `production` (`VITE_FINANCE_NATIVE_PROFILE=production`): `tuturuuu-finance`. Profile `staging` (default): the staging Worker name. `workers_dev` and preview URLs are off; the config declares no routes |
| Host | Production: `finance.tuturuuu.com/` and `tuturuuu.com/finance` (no trailing slash required). Staging admits only its profile's reserved root and mount hosts. Each artifact refuses the other profile and unlisted hosts |
| Bindings | `ASSETS` (worker-first, no SPA fallback) |
| Vars (production profile, names) | `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_APP_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`, `FINANCE_APP_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`; values live in `cloudflare/native-profiles.json`, never mixed with the staging profile |
| Secrets (names) | `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`. The Worker refuses to serve without them |
| Build | `bun turbo:local run build --filter=@tuturuuu/finance^...`, then `VITE_FINANCE_NATIVE_PROFILE=production bun run --cwd apps/finance build:cloudflare`. `finance-cloudflare.yaml` builds the same profile and uploads the sealed `finance-cutover-production-<sha>` artifact; it never publishes |
| Routing | Root cutover: `finance.tuturuuu.com/*`. Apex cutover also needs exact `/finance` and `/finance/*` routed to this Worker. Capture both routes before changing them |
| Prior Vercel deployment | Not recorded in the repository. Capture the production deployment id, source SHA and the DNS record id, content, proxy state and TTL before the flip |

## Rollback

Restore the captured root and apex Worker routes (including exact `/finance`) and restore the captured DNS
payload; assign only the Finance hostname to the captured immutable Vercel
deployment if needed. Never promote the Vercel project as a whole. Freeze
production sync during the flip and watch, because `vercel-production-finance.yaml`
runs on `production` pushes and a new Vercel deployment would move the alias the
rollback relies on. The Worker holds no state and the rollback touches no data.

## Smoke

```bash
node scripts/native-cutover/smoke.mjs --origin https://finance.tuturuuu.com --app finance --expect native
curl -s https://finance.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info     # commitHash equals the sealed artifact's source SHA
curl -sI https://finance.tuturuuu.com/                  # signed out: redirect to the central login
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://finance.tuturuuu.com/api/v1/workspaces   # denied without a session, never 5xx
```

Only exact GET and HEAD `/api/build-info` are public. The rollback smoke is the
same runner with `--expect legacy`. After the flip, watch 5xx rate, authentication
failures and p95 latency for 30 to 60 minutes and roll back on regression.

## Local Worker qualification and apex activation

A clean checkout needs `bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and the
workspace dependency build in the table before `build:cloudflare`; the app build
alone cannot resolve `@tuturuuu/internal-api` until its `dist` exports exist.
`bun run build` is the legacy Next build; use `build:cloudflare` for Workers.
Generate build identity with `bun scripts/ci/generate-build-metadata.ts` from the
repository root before building. Run `CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA=<source-sha> node
--experimental-strip-types --test
apps/finance/cloudflare/native-built-worker.runtime.mjs` from that root. Node
versions with default type stripping do not need the experimental flag. Install
Chromium through `apps/web`'s pinned Playwright first, or explicitly set
`FINANCE_TEST_SYSTEM_CHROME=1` to test the locally installed Google Chrome.
CI keeps the pinned Chromium default. The runtime uses random
throwaway signing keys, synthetic data and denied provider authentication.

The emitted suite exercises root and mount, slashless `/finance`, EN/VI signed
SSR, invalid signatures, private caching, reserved Web APIs, framing, and asset
status/MIME. The Vite preset's `experimental.renderBuiltUrl` keeps JS-imported
assets under the request base. Router links and owned APIs use the shared app
base; Web-owned APIs remain Web-owned. Finance disables service-worker
registration (`OfflineProvider register={false}`), so it claims no root or
mounted service-worker scope. The bridge emits no font asset and uses CSS/system
fonts; font HTTP smoke is inapplicable until font files are introduced.

For the canonical apex flip, Rex sets `TTR_ONE_ORIGIN_FINANCE=on` and
`TTR_ONE_ORIGIN_FINANCE_REDIRECT_STATUS=301` on the production Worker after apex
acceptance. The shared handler redirects root navigation to exactly
`https://tuturuuu.com/finance`, preserving deep paths and query strings. Machine
paths (`/api`, `/assets`, `/_serverFn`, `/.well-known`) keep serving on the old
host. With the variables absent both admitted hosts serve; `shadow` provides
an observation mode. No provider routes or canonical settings are changed by a
local build. Apex session, OAuth callback and real provider acceptance remain
release gates; capture the prior variables alongside routes for rollback.
